name: tmux
description: A pane listing the interactive Claude Code sessions in the current tmux session, showing each one's state (Active, Needs you, Idle) and highlighting the one facing the user; click one to bring it to the front, its [x] twice to close it, or [new] to start another.

new_session_command.title: New session command
new_session_command.description: The command line the [new] row types into the new tmux window's shell
